verdict.summary: Minimal, well-scoped CSS override to fix WCAG AA contrast compliance issue. No correctness bugs or design concerns identified.

correctness.notes: CSS selector targeting is precise and limited to Ace Tomorrow Night theme. Color override (#FF8080) verified to meet WCAG AA contrast requirement (6.811:1 vs 4.5:1 requirement).

performance.notes: Single CSS rule addition has negligible performance impact.

security.notes: No security implications—CSS styling only, no user input or data handling.

accessibility.notes: Directly addresses accessibility issue. Improves color contrast for users with low vision.

maintainability.notes: Change is isolated to AceEditor component. Clear comment explains purpose (EPMCDME-8518). No new complexity introduced.

tests.notes: No tests required for CSS styling change. Visual verification sufficient.
